correctness.rationale: Starting from equations (20)–(25) of arXiv:2609.32651v1, antisymmetrization gives a scalar multiple of an explicit alternating \(5\times5\) matrix. A packaged symbolic calculation proves its determinant is zero and all twenty-five cofactors are \((-1)^{r+c}X_rX_cS^2\), where \(S=X_0+\cdots+X_4\). For actual conjugate coordinates, \(S=\operatorname{Tr}_{F/K}(x)\) and every \(X_i\) is nonzero. These identities force ranks \(4\) off the trace hyperplane and \(2\) on its nonzero part; the trace-kernel cardinality then yields the exact commuting-pair count.
